visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pair of hands lifts a large round wooden bamboo steamer lid, releasing a thick cloud of white steam. Inside, two large, fluffy white steamed buns rest on a dark mesh liner within the steamer. The background is a slightly out-of-focus street scene with hints of red festive decorations. (2) Three large, pale white steamed buns are shown resting on a white cloth inside a bamboo steamer, with steam rising around them. The buns have a smooth, slightly textured surface typical of handmade dough. (3) A woman wearing a black face mask, a blue apron, and a striped long-sleeve shirt uses metal tongs to move a large, steaming white bun. Beside her, several tall stacks of bamboo steamers are piled on a stainless steel counter in a partially outdoor storefront setting. (4) A woman in a blue apron and cap walks toward the camera from inside a shop labeled with a red sign. Inside the brightly lit workspace, two other staff members wearing masks and aprons work at a large stainless steel table preparing dough. (5) Close-up of hands wearing plastic gloves packing several steamed buns into individual plastic bags. In the background, more stacks of bamboo steamers and a white cloth-covered surface are visible under bright indoor lighting. (6) A hand holds a large bun torn open to reveal a bright yellow melted cheese filling mixed with savory meat and corn kernels. The bun's interior is fluffy and porous, showing the texture of the steamed dough. (7) A person holds a whole, white steamed bun inside a white cardboard box. Two other buns are visible in the box, one marked with a red dot on top. (8) A close-up view of a bun being pulled apart by two hands, revealing a dense filling of light-colored bamboo shoot cubes and minced pork. The steam is visible rising from the hot filling. (9) A close-up of a bun with several small red dots on its surface. It is torn open to show a savory meat filling mixed with green elements, identified as peeled chili peppers. (10) A bun is torn open to showcase a rich curry-colored meat filling with visible corn kernels and a thick, melted cheese center. The hands holding it are steady and clear in the frame. (11) A cheese bun is pulled apart, showing long strands of melted yellow cheese nestled within the layers of the white, fluffy dough. The lighting is bright and emphasizes the texture of the bread. (12) A bun is opened to reveal a deep, dark black sesame paste filling. The contrast between the stark white bun and the rich black interior is striking under the natural daylight. (13) A bun with red dots is torn open to show a smooth, dark purple-brown red bean paste filling. The dough appears soft and elastic as it is pulled apart. (14) A red and white sign or price list is shown attached to a pink pole outdoors. It lists various bun types and prices in Chinese characters, with some text highlighted in red boxes. (15) A white cardboard box containing four large steamed buns is held up against a blurred street background. One bun has red dots, indicating a specific flavor. (16) The final shot shows the exterior of the 'Jixiang Baozi' shop. It features a large orange sign with food illustrations and Chinese text. A staff member is seen working near stacks of steamers under the shop's awning.
